rule.message:
All freshmen in the College of Science and Engineering must complete CSE 1001: First-Year Experience.
All students planning to pursue a Biomedical Engineering major should complete BMEN 1601: UG Seminar.
All degree seeking students must complete the University's Liberal Education requirements .
At least 29 upper division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus.
View  Four-year Plans  for the College of Science and Engineering.
View a sample plan for this program. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

Complete any sub-plan requirements that apply to you: Bioelectricity/Bioinstrumentation, Biomaterials, Biomechanics, Biomedical Transport Processes, Cell and Molecular Bioengineering, Cell and Tissue Engineering, Digital Health, Medical Device Design, Neural Engineering, Custom Sub-Plan, Integrated B.Bm.E./M.S. Program. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
